horoscope: You’re in a powerful cycle for self-development and laying the groundwork for future success, dear Aries. Today, communication issues tend to dominate. You may have an epiphany or realization about a health issue, a solution, or a work or service matter, and you can enjoy a sense of excitement. You may spend a lot of time thinking about how to improve any of these things, and conversations or incoming news can lead to new beginnings. Good energy is with you to sort things out and gain more information about work and health matters logically, though emotional considerations are still necessary. It can be challenging to see what’s real and what’s hyped right now, in fact. Watch for a business-like insensitivity or impatience with people since people are very sensitive with a Lunar Eclipse about to occur. As well, your mind might say “yes” to things that your heart has yet to process. This is a time to notice imbalances in your life, particularly between working and resting, or between physical and emotional/mental needs.

Mercury and the Sun meet in your solar fifth house today, dear Taurus, and there can be new details about creative projects, a relationship, or finances that will ultimately help you solve problems and make decisions. Your communication is entertaining, and you are taking more pride in your ideas and creations. A romantic revelation might be imminent, or a creative project or relationship could reach a turning point, and observations made now are likely to be significant. Assessing recent ideas can be beneficial. You can be highly engaged on a mental level, but consider that a Lunar Eclipse is about to occur, too, and emotions are building. Watch for feeling pressured to say yes or to throw yourself into something before your heart is ready. An overdue conversation related to any of these themes can happen now, and it can set you in a new direction. There is undoubtedly some push-pull energy now as you have much going on in your personal life, and the challenge is to balance all your interests.

There can be an important, motivating conversation or news today, dear Gemini. The desire to reach out to someone you love is big right now. You might see opportunities to put the negative elements of the past behind you, particularly in a relationship with a loved one. Family matters are in focus, and a personal or emotional breakthrough is entirely possible. There can be big ideas and meaningful ideas related to long-term projects, improving security, family, property, and home. You’re seeking clarity in your personal life now, but with a Lunar Eclipse also on its way, emotions are just as big, and it can be difficult to make a decision. While things may be coming together on the home front or regarding living conditions, and ideas can blossom now, energy levels are up and down, and responsibilities are strong on you. You have much going on both personally and professionally, and there is a temptation to pile more on, which should be tamed. Keep things simple for the best results.

As Mercury and the Sun meet in your communication sector, dear Cancer, you’re paying extra attention to details, news, and ideas emerging now. It can be a mentally busy time, and a plan or project can blossom. This energy helps you sort things out and solve problems, though energy levels may not match mental activity as a Lunar Eclipse approaches, amping up emotions. Words expressed now can pull up emotions, and it’s wise to keep things under control. At the same time, your ideas can be in demand now, and new details emerging about studies, trips, or projects can be well worth your while. Be careful that you don’t make all of your decisions from the head or your ego and ignore your heart in the process, but also avoid swinging to the other extreme. For now, you could be in a situation of “too much information,” which can be overwhelming.

The Sun and Mercury meet in your resources sector, dear Leo, and there is a strong focus of interest and conversation on business matters, finances, personal possessions, issues of worth or respect, and values. This transit can bring a turning point or fruition of a project. Something dawns on you, or important news comes in now that illuminates matters related to money, income, and relationships. This is very logical energy, and with a Lunar Eclipse also on its way, you should watch for moments when a more sentimental approach is preferable. It can be a little too easy to overdo spending or other indulgences at this time since you can have a hard time deciding where to put your energies. Part of you wants to stir things up and test your feelings, and another wants to enjoy what you already have. Aim to avoid swinging from an overly analytical to a too-emotional frame of mind, when a balance between the two is ideal. Prepare for revelations and possible dilemmas, but aim to observe before making impactful decisions.

The Sun and Mercury meet in your sign today, dear Virgo, and whether or not you want it, you’re heard loud and clear! Your communications are impactful, but a Lunar Eclipse in your opposite sign is also about to occur, pushing emotional buttons. The combination can be rather intense and sometimes confusing. You can come to significant realizations and epiphanies, but things are a little raw, so you may want to take some time with them. Note, too, that others are talking about you, more so than usual. You might be privy to missing details or new information. Tension may also arise between your desire for companionship and your urge for more freedom or independence. While you can be tempted to push your agenda, it’s better not to push yourself, anyone, or anything.

You can experience a strong urge or need to talk about the past right now, dear Libra. The Sun and Mercury align in your privacy sector, and you can have an epiphany or experience illumination regarding a private or past matter. You might see something you missed, or a conversation can bring up new information. A topic from the past can reawaken today, or you see an old matter in a new way. You are better able to communicate or rationalize a matter that, before today, was difficult to express and understand. Still, a Lunar Eclipse is about to occur, and while mental energy is intense, emotions are building, too, and the result can be confusing. Words can have more sting than usual, for example. Part of you wants to tuck yourself away, but the need to work through your routines, work, or daily affairs is strong. Whether you’re seeking escape and peace of mind or want to put problem areas behind you, it’s best to take things one step at a time now.

You can experience sudden ideas or realizations today, dear Scorpio, and your social life is likely to be quite animated. You’re seeking clarity on a plan or friendship now, or you could be exploring new ideas for long-term projects. It’s a fantastic period for cultivating contacts, getting involved, networking, and sharing ideas, time, and energy. Valuable new connections can be made. Progress occurs through groups, like-minded people, friends, networking, associates, and experimental or innovative ideas and approaches. Your personal happiness goals or cherished causes can be in focus. Still, there's a tendency to swing from an overly objective approach to an overly emotional frame of mind today and tomorrow, and that can cause confusion. You might feel torn between personal interests and a commitment to someone. It may be best to release some ambition, tension, or pressure, and simplify things as much as possible so you can make sense of the epiphanies and discoveries happening now as we approach a Lunar Eclipse.

There is a focus on your professional life, responsibilities, and image now, dear Sagittarius, as the Sun and Mercury meet at the top of your solar chart. People can notice you for your efforts, skills, and voice. You might receive special attention in a public or professional sense, or your communications are particularly impactful. Because we're building to a Lunar Eclipse in the opposite sector, you may benefit from being a little more guarded with what/how you communicate, as things can blow out of proportion at this time. New insights into your career or life path can emerge, or a significant clarification or a meaningful realization can occur. Ideas for new directions can be valuable now. You may be verbalizing an idea you’ve only thought about, which frames it in a new way and supports your thought process. Push-pull energy is at play now, and while it's best to avoid hasty actions, it's a powerful time for self-discovery.

Especially with studies, travel, communications, or publishing matters, details might fill in today, offering you a new perspective, dear Capricorn. Illumination can occur on a mental level. You may feel compelled or excited to share your ideas, beliefs, and personal philosophies with others. Excitement and motivation to soak up information and acquire new knowledge are strong now. You want to move out of your comfort zone regarding learning, thinking, and doing. You may make a significant discovery or connection now. You express yourself with more enthusiasm and faith, and this goes over very well with others. Even so, you may struggle to focus or concentrate today and tomorrow, as emotions are intense and building, and it may not be easy to discern fact from fiction.

The Sun and Mercury meet in your intimacy sector today, dear Aquarius, and this can be a real nudge towards looking within for answers. It’s also a prompt to seek out a deeper involvement in a project, venture, or relationship. You’re not interested in fluff at the moment as you pursue more meaningful or absorbing experiences. As such, some endeavors are likely to fall by the wayside. It’s a time for clearing the air. Still, it’s important to watch for an overly technical or intellectual approach to self-expression today and tomorrow, with a Lunar Eclipse about to occur. Reaching an epiphany is likely now, but you should take your time with what emerges. Take steps to wind down with commitments or responsibilities at cross-purposes, as you’re not entirely sure if you want to go your own way or lean on others. Try not to worry too much and aim to enjoy the moment.

Mercury and the Sun meet in your opposing sign today, dear Pisces, generating much mental activity, but in spots, you may feel as if it’s against your purposes. You can be doing a lot of processing, sorting, and organizing your thoughts and ideas, and interactions or conversations with someone can help jumpstart critical thinking. Some emotional detachment can be quite helpful but difficult with a Lunar Eclipse about to occur in your sign! It may be a good idea to let others lead the conversation and listen carefully, but don’t let the chatter or noise confuse your own emotional epiphanies. It can be challenging to juggle all that’s going on now, but it can be rewarding. Ultimately, you’re likely to discover a missing puzzle piece of information, or have especially meaningful conversations and conclusions. If others’ demands on you feel a little excessive, it’s a time for considering your real needs. Aim to pace yourself regardless. You’re experiencing the world around you through the lens of your emotions right now, and this makes things a little bigger and more colorful than usual.
